headlines.title: Pig kidney works for a record 271 days inside the body of American patient
headlines.description: An American lived for a record 271 days with a transplanted pig kidney before Boston doctors replaced it with a human one earlier this year — a transplant that has kept him alive ever since, researchers said Thursday.

headlines.title: Map: Track the spread of measles in the U.S.
headlines.description: NBC News is tracking confirmed measles case counts and state infection tallies. This data will be updated regularly.

headlines.title: How New Tech is Helping Aging Adults Stay in Their Home
headlines.description: From medical alert watches, to A.I. companion robots, new technology is making it easier for aging adults to stay in their homes. Reporting for Saturday TODAY, NBC’s Vicky Nguyen takes a closer look at this changing phenomenon, and pays a visit to a couple who were able to stay in their home by making it safer and more accessible.

headlines.title: Surgeon Shares Latest in Prostate Cancer Treatments
headlines.description: September is prostate cancer awareness month, so board-certified surgeon Dr. Cedrek McFadden stops by TODAY to share the latest in prostate cancer treatments. He talks about different types of diagnosis, how family genetics come into play, when to get screened, and more.

headlines.title: A first of its kind organ transplant technique tried on a human subject
headlines.description: Meet the first-ever patient to receive stem cells from their donor, in the hope of avoiding toxic anti-rejection drugs. NBC News' Camila Bernal spoke to the patient who received a liver transplant from her sister.

headlines.title: Start Your Journey to Longevity With These Wellness Routines
headlines.description: From strength training for healthy aging to improving mobility and nutrition that promotes longevity, TODAY fitness contributor Stephanie Mansour, board-certified orthopedic physical therapist Karena Wu, and Start TODAY nutrition editor Natalie Rizzo share activities, meals, and motivation for your daily wellness routines.

headlines.title: All the best deals from Ulta’s fall 21 Days of Beauty Event, according to a beauty writer
headlines.description: Ulta’s 21 Days of Beauty Sale is officially back, featuring daily deals of 50% off brands like Cecred, Supergoop, Farmacy and more.

headlines.title: Macy’s Labor Day sale has up to 75% off Dyson, Shark, Ninja and more
headlines.description: Macy’s Labor Day Sale has some of the best deals of the year, with up to 75% off appliances, bedding, apparel and more, from Dyson, Ninja, The North Face and other brands.

headlines.title: The absolute best muscle pain relief creams, tested by someone who’s always sore
headlines.description: You can get muscle pain relief creams over the counter to soothe muscles, joints, arthritis and inflammation. Experts share how to find the most effective options.

headlines.title: Jazz shoes are the new ‘it’ shoes for fall — but are they supportive?
headlines.description: The jazz shoe trend is everywhere, but are they actually good for your feet? Podiatrists break down the risks, who should avoid them, and the best supportive picks.

headlines.title: When is it safe to return home after a wildfire? California becomes first state to pass standards
headlines.description: California is poised to become the first U.S. state to set standards for testing and remediation for smoke contamination from wildfires, with a pair of bills passed Monday.

headlines.title: Her son fed goats at a petting zoo. He might’ve been exposed to rabies.
headlines.description: Three baby goats at a North Carolina petting zoo tested positive for rabies, sparking a statewide effort to track down everyone who interacted with the animals.
